entries.en: to become sad, to be grieved; vexation, distress

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑为手脚肿麻之症（西语谓手脚 entrugido，g. 互见 Bullido）；汉字栏录作「肚」，与音读不谐
entries.en: 〔damaged in original; gloss uncertain〕 apparently 'numb or swollen hands and feet' (cf. Bullido); the Chinese char 肚 does not match the recorded reading Bŷ/Bȳ
entries.notes: M/R 两栏均标 [残]；「Entrugido」疑为 entumido（麻木）一类词形，汉字与音读未能互证，故降为低置信。

entries.en: to send (a letter or goods) through someone; to transmit, mail

entries.zh: 遣用，差遣出使（embaxada 使团）〔首字污损难辨，原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to dispatch, to send (on an embassy) 〔first syllable illegible; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: M 栏首字 T99（污损难辨）；据 H「用」并参同页第 9 条「enviar embaxada＝使用」定为遣用、差使义。

entries.en: to send (a person) on an errand; to dispatch

entries.zh: 送，馈赠（作为献礼、人情而遣送）
entries.en: to send as a gift or offering; to present
to pay, to remit (send in payment); to hand over, deliver

entries.zh: 差使，差遣（遣人办事、出使）
entries.en: to dispatch; to send (someone) on a mission or errand

entries.zh: 使用，差遣任使（遣人出使）
entries.en: to send (a person) on an embassy; to employ, dispatch

entries.zh: 寄探，遣人递书问候（致意、探问）〔第二字「探/採」存疑〕
entries.en: to send word of greeting or visit; to send respects 〔2nd char 探/採 uncertain〕
entries.notes: H 栏第二字 [疑:探/採]；音读 tâm 与「探」相合，据以取探问、致候义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕汉字栏「行狀」：行述，记生平行谊之文；西语栏残损，所指未定
entries.en: 〔damaged in original; gloss uncertain〕 Chinese 行狀: an account of one's conduct, a biographical sketch; the Spanish head is damaged
entries.notes: L 栏标 [残]，M 栏首字 [疑:guia/heng]；「largamon de」不可解，行狀义仅据 H 与 R 音「hîōng chāong」。

entries.en: to send soldiers to fight; to dispatch troops

entries.zh: 打发，遣送（把人打发、发送出去）
entries.en: to send off, to dispatch; to dismiss (someone with a task)

entries.zh: 下帖，投帖（遣人送请帖邀约）〔西语栏残损〕
entries.en: to send an invitation card or note; to deliver an invitation 〔Spanish column damaged〕
entries.notes: L 栏 [残] 且含未展开缩写 villereᵖ；下帖义据 H/M/R 三栏（hē hiâp / hīa tiē）清晰。

entries.zh: 灯谜，猜燈猜（节庆悬灯供猜射之谜语）〔西语栏残损；第三字「猜/清」存疑〕
entries.en: lantern riddles (enigmas hung on lanterns at the festival/Pascua) 〔Spanish damaged; 3rd char uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏标 [残]；「lina na la phscua」读作 linterna（灯）/Pascua（节期），与「猜燈猜」相合。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕齿部字，H 疑作「齒踞/菌距」，义未定
entries.en: 〔damaged in original; gloss uncertain〕 a tooth-related term (H uncertain: 齒踞/菌距); undetermined
entries.notes: L 栏 [残:后接涂改删除词不可辨]；「Enquias」疑即 encías（齿龈）一类词，然义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 齿仁（第二字「仁/齦」存疑），疑指齿龈、牙龈
entries.notes: H 栏 [疑:仁/齦]；西语 enquias≈encías（齿龈），与「齒齦」相合，故疑取牙龈义。
